message.Title: Generally Available: Agent Loop in Azure Logic Apps [Standard]

Body.Content:
Announcing the general availability of Agent Loop in Azure Logic Apps (Standard), a breakthrough capability that redefines how organizations design and automate business processes. 

Agent Loop enables you to move beyond traditional workflow automation by bringing agentic intelligence into every process. Instead of simply executing predefined steps, Logic Apps can now create goal-driven, adaptive workflows that reason, decide, and act autonomously based on real-time context. 

With Agent Loop, you can: 

  • Build goal-driven workflows that iteratively refine actions until objectives are met. 
  • Use 1,400+ enterprise connectors to give agents real-time access to business systems and data. 
  • Integrate seamlessly with Azure AI Foundry, enabling flexible model and AI service choices. 
  • Ensure traceable reasoning loops with full auditability for compliance and troubleshooting. 

Agent Loop marks a major step forward in bringing agentic capabilities to enterprise integration, making Logic Apps the foundation for intelligent, adaptive business processes. 

Learn more:
  • About building agentic workflows
  • Get started with Agent Loop in Azure Logic Apps.
